newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat market steady, awaits Iraq news.
newsitem.headline: French wheat market steady, awaits Iraq news.

text.p: French wheat prices were steady on Monday with exporters awaiting the outcome of a wheat tender launched by Iraq.
Wheat into Rouen for January delivery was bid at 865 francs per tonne, unchanged from Friday.
Iraq is expected to decide later on Monday on a tender for the import of 100,000 tonnes of French wheat in March and April.
Exporters expect Iraq to end up buying more wheat from France, possibly as much as 300-350,000 tonnes but there has been no official word of a deal yet.
Iraq has already bought 300,000 tonnes of French wheat under a United Nations oil-for-food plan that went into effect on December 10.
